verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents a REST API, so this axis applies, but the evidence shows no downloadable machine-readable spec. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404. The open-source Python module and llms.txt are a developer building block and documentation, not an API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
